messages:
Jamie (growth): Quick sync — we need a 1-pager (external facing) that ties secure deploy modes + SLA guarantees to our launch posts and webinar funnel. Focus: security, predictable latency/cost, and inbound routing for field.
Priya (product): +1. Target buyers: platform engineers, CISO, infra leads. Key proof points: Dedicated throughput, Private VPC + KMS, and fallbacks. Keep it one page.
Alex P (eng): For benchmarks we can call out: p50/p95 generation latency for a common 2k prompt (p50 ~ 80ms, p95 ~ 220ms) on Redwood Dedicated with autoscale. Cost ballpark for 1M tokens: $80–$120 depending on quant profile. I can supply short bullets.
Samir (field): Also need routing play: inbound tags -> "security-inquiry", "sla-commit", "private-deploy". Recommend auto-assign to AE tier-2 for security inquiries, and to solutions-eng for Private deploy evals.
Lina (design): I can mock a one-pager layout by EOD tomorrow. Do we want a hero comparison table (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)?
Jamie (growth): Yes — hero micro-table + 3 quick callouts (SLA, Data Controls, Cost predictability). Add a tiny benchmark strip: latency + throughput + cost.
Priya (product): Messaging iteration: start with conservative claims (typical/verified numbers) and a short note: "Results measured on representative workloads; contact us for custom benchmarks." Keeps legal safe.
Alex P (eng): I'll paste a 2-line sample benchmark block for the doc: ```Benchmarks (internal): Hosted: p95 gen (2k) ~ 270ms, Dedicated (reserved T4/Tesla): p95 ~ 220ms, Private (on-prem cert): varies — sample fed infra: p95 ~ 180ms. Throughput: Dedicated pool supports 600 reqs/min for 512-token avg with autoscale.``` Use only the first two lines externally; rest in appendix.
Samir (field): Webinar hook: "Secure Inference at Scale: SLA patterns & migration checklist". Speakers: Priya (product), Alex P (eng), customer seat (TBD). Target date: 3 weeks out. CTA on one-pager: register + request benchmark + schedule PoC.
Jamie (growth): For launch posts: short social blurbs + PR quote. Example post copy idea: "Redwood Inference now offers predictable SLAs across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments — see our one‑page brief and sign up for an on-demand benchmark." Keep link to registration form.
Lina (design): Assets question — do we want an icon set for data controls (KMS, audit logs, VPC)? I can include 3 icons and a tiny architecture diagram.
Priya (product): Yes. Also include a tiny rollout checklist: "1) Identify compliance requirements 2) Choose deploy mode 3) Baseline traffic 4) Request benchmark 5) Migrate with canary".
Samir (field): Inbound routing specifics for Ops/Sales: email -> crm tag "secure_eval". Slack notifications to #sales-ops with summary. Auto-open case in support if customer requests Private/on-prem.
Jamie (growth): Distribution plan: landing page (one-pager PDF) -> blog post summary -> social -> webinar -> SDR nurture seq (3 touchpoints). We'll need copy for SDR touching on costs and SLA guarantees.
Alex P (eng): I'll assemble the internal benchmark spreadsheet and send link to Priya and Samir by EOD today.
OpsBot: Reminder: Compliance review required for any statements about SLAs. Submit to legal-review channel within 24h.
Jamie (growth): Action items: Alex - benchmarks by EOD, Lina - mock by tomorrow EOD, Priya - checklist + webinar coord, Samir - routing mapping + AE assignment. I'll draft external copy v1 and drop here for iteration.
Priya (product): Sounds good. Ping me when the mock is ready and I'll review tone for CISO audience.
Samir (field): I'll start mapping example customer routing flows (Finance, HealthCare, Gov) and share a matrix.
Jamie (growth): Perfect. Quick note — keep the one-pager scannable (no more than 350 words). We'll iterate content here. :rocket:
